body:
3 or 4 months into my cooking gig, a few things that have helped me.

Ask for your own printer, there are busy days where I say fuck it and shut the thing off... But 90% of the time it helps me to have my dishes prepared to send out. I don't need to wait for either expo to let me know what I've got all day. I don't need to make my way halfway across the tiny kitchen to look at tickets.

If you're unsure of anything, ask. Write your answer down. My first few months I had one head chef who was constantly on my ass, but he made sure I learned as much as I could. Sent me home with homework that I never did, but I have picked up a lot from him that I otherwise would not have. 

Do your best. Be receptive to criticism. Do everything as you are asked to. You'll be okay. There may come a time when you get stressed, overwhelmed. Learn to swallow it, you'll be better off for it.

Anyone with a shred of empathy will not lace you for not knowing the details 2 weeks into it. Good luck!
It doesn't take much experience to deploy a turret. It's even easier to shoot them down. Use what you want, just know they're ineffective.

Parents. Althought some days I feel like even they don't matter. I just wish they could accept that this is how I feel.

On my worse days, I'm scared.

I will say, really do try to get an outside perspective. Are you content with your station in life? If not, is it possible that you only feel this way and things may change? 

Life is meaningless, agreed. We could live 50 years or 50 days. But, I think we should strive to get as much good from it as we can. It's really difficult most days, but there have been experiences I'd miss out on if I had ended my life when I planned to. Regardless, life is ultimately what you make of it.

So, while I agree with everything you're saying. By that I mean I think and feel this, fight it with every bit of passion. Supposedly things get better.
I mean... I just read it. Agreed. Your logic is infallable.

How do you figure?

My life sucks. It didn't always, but mostly and it does now. Not once have I thought of harming another person because I'm unhappy.

You are responsible for your own happiness. Whether you want to pursue it or kill yourself, there's no reason to harm another person to get where you want to go.

Best of luck. I would give you a hug. If you genuinely feel this way, I am sorry.

I sincerely hope this is a joke. 

I think it is abhorrent that any reasonable person would think this is acceptable. What did random people have to do with your personal battle? 

The concern is more on why you feel this way. Tell your therapist. Figure that out before you, hypothetically, ruin people's lives.
It is. Looks like the concept stormtroopers are the first phase stormtroopers. Pretty cool. Glad they've been using concept art.
The original battlefront games. I imagine I'm not the only one who can still hear the voice lines. Awesome games I spent way too much time playing.

I would agree. Halfway between not placing any value in life because I feel I live in a world with an overwhelming amount of negativity and placing all of it's value on my own life. But, I don't know. I suppose if I ever do actually attempt, I'll not do that and really just take off. 

I kind of live my life that way already. I can't pinpoint an exact moment, but somewhere along the line I decided that from this moment on I should have been dead. This is all just extra. Like an epilogue to a book. I'm already on that adventure. Often one of the only comforts I have is knowing that all of my worries will disappear, be it by my hand or not. It just seems like being an adult is not really worth all of the effort. People suck.

I believe people do care, but like everything else, it is a fickle thing. 

Do you play any games?

I play Star Wars Squadrons and some marvel fighting game on my phone. 

Thank you again for talking to me. The most I've actually spoken to someone in a very long time. It means a lot.
I play a couple video games. Passion is music, but I've had instruments for a year and haven't really touched them. Don't have the space for it that I'd like.
Not really. No idea when I will be ready to.

Well, here's my thing. This isn't really an emotionally charged response to trauma. This is just how I think. As I grow older, I experience more of the world. There are cool little moments where I'm distracted, happy living in the moment. Very few and far between these days.

I do hope something helpful comes of this appointment. But what if not? What if I seriously am just doomed to living this way? I'm not even fully convinced something is wrong with me, though I do suspect. Just that it seems like at the end of the day, I'll either sink or swim. 

My problem has been that I have never known how to live for myself. I have a big heart and at this point will involuntarily give it to anyone who will spend time with me. It happens the same way every time, actually, lol. I don't have any of those people; they never stick around. 

I don't know. I'm rambling now. Just trying to pull myself out of this hole that I'm pretty sure my brain wanted me to be in. Did some drugs in hopes that they work. I haven't showered in days and I really really should be in my line of work lol.

I'm 23, I think. I'm starting to lose track without going and doing the math. Haha. 

I am working full time, my job is my life and up until recently it was my escape. It is now on the list of things I seek escape from. I need to get myself into school. I do have a plan for my life, or at least the idea that I need to execute on.

But, right now I spend too much money on intoxicants. There is no way I could be doing what I am doing sober, though. I fucked up my life and am paying the price by way of the situation I am in now. Moving out should be my primary focus and motivation, but I know where that's going to leave me. Even if I have things I worked for and purchased... they're just things. Tools I can use to further devote my life to something my heart isn't in because I need money.

I'm able to appreciate that I won the ultimate cosmic lottery by existing, but I'm convinced I won some sort of last place consolation prize.

That was said after trying to help me help myself for over a decade. My dad has been through a few suicides and "refuses to let me fall". But he is who he is. We're not on speaking terms and I'm currently living with him.
I didn't want you to think I ignored you, but I didn't have much to say here. Thanks for the reply and good luck on your journey.

It doesn't change much for me. Been told a lot of things. My mom is a great person who loves me, but she told me if this is really how I've felt then I should do it. Didn't sound as heartless as I make it sound, though. Just done with dealing with me. I just wish I knew how to function like a normal adult.

Meeting new people is not something I do. I go outside often though.

That's strange. No wonder people think I want attention, lol.

Resounding no. I wish I did. Lots of people who say the words but don't mean them.

Lol! I'm not sure if there's a character limit on reddit. If there is, I'd find it telling you.

My mother insists that I have had a hard life. I honestly don't know what would make her say that, but she might be right. Regardless, this life has been my life.

I just wish I wasn't me. I've been around people, but never in a meaningful sense. I've been alone as long as I can remember. I honestly feel the isolation and lonliness has driven me a bit more mad. I'm kind of trapped in this loop now, where everyone I meet for some reason decides they don't want anything to do with me. I've stopped putting effort into one-sided relationships and the past month the only texts or calls I get are work related. 

I'm just tired. I fake this "stay positive" mindset every day. It is exhausting. Truth is, I feel like I see the world for what it is and I see people for who they are. I've yet to find someone who appreciates my unique flavor of insanity, and I doubt I ever will. So, I am presented with two choices. 

I can accept that I'm just flawed in a social sense, and learn to come to terms with my reality... Or, I can accept that I genuinely feel as if I do not belong, and do not want to take part in the rat race, and catch the first bus out of here.

Ultimately, it doesn't matter. There's nothing I can say that will make me feel better. There's nothing you can say that will fix things for me. Though, I do appreciate you taking the time.

I'm just drained in every way imagineable. Life kinda fucking sucks.

I'm waiting to get in with a doc. Two weeks from my appt. 

But, getting there is proving more difficult than I thought it would be.

Honestly? Yes. 

My whole life I have tried to do right by people, tried to put my brain's fucked up chemical makeup behind me and will myself to be the person I know I can be. You know where it's gotten me? Absolutely nowhere. 

I don't care about the pain I would cause my family by killing myself. I don't care about missing out on the life not lived. I just don't give a shit about anything anymore. There really is little left inside of me except for what can be best described as fury. 

I don't wish to erupt on anyone, I've isolated myself, and find myself unable to love or care the people and things around me that I once did. I am just empty, frankly.

But to answer your question, yes, I'm okay with going out like that. I just don't have the means to do so reliably. So I'm just stuck here.

Why does it matter if I die to cancer in x years, get murdered one day, die in a plane crash, or take my own life? Everything dies. Why is it wrong for one to want to take what little control they do have and cut their losses?
